description: Henter granskningsfunn på én eksplisitt oppdrags-ID: kode, tittel, beløp, merking, status, gjeldende vurdering, spor og kildens etikett med revly_url. Dette er ikke feilinformasjonspostene i funn_rad og ikke antallene i activity.funn på hent_oppdrag_tilstand, som er feilinformasjon. Et innebygd agentverktøy med samme navn leser et annet register. Lang beskrivelse er utelatt. Fortrolige funn er med og merket fortrolig. «Mangler kilde» betyr at kilden mangler, aldri at funnet er i orden. Filteret vurdering lik ikke_vurdert tar også med funn uten vurderingsrad. Høyst 80 funn og 20 kilder per funn.

endret_siden.description: Bare funn endret, eller vurdert, etter dette tidspunktet.

mangler_kilde.description: true: bare funn uten kilde. false: bare funn med minst én kilde.

oppdrag_id.description: Eksplisitt oppdrags-ID fra Revly. Oppslag uten ID er ikke tillatt.

vurdering.description: Gjeldende vurdering. ikke_vurdert tar også med funn uten vurderingsrad.

name: hent_funn

outputSchema.description: Granskningsfunn for one engagement. Not the misstatement rows in funn_rad or the misstatement counts in activity.funn.

anyOf.description: Minimal evidence that this read was recorded.

client_receipt.description: Whether the connected client confirmed receipt. Revly reports "unknown".

result_produced.description: True when Revly produced the read result.

fortrolig.description: True when the finding is confidential inside the engagement.

status.description: Latest assessment status. The comment is on hent_funnvurderinger.

gjeldende_vurdering.description: Latest assessment. Null means no assessment row yet — treat as ikke_vurdert, never as OK or cleared.

kilde_antall.description: Sources on the finding. Higher than kilder.length when truncated.

revly_url.description: Link to the granskningsfunn page for this engagement.

mangler_kilde.description: True when the finding has no source. That is missing, not OK.

merking.description: dokumentert, opplysning_fra_part or hypotese. Null until marked.

spor.description: Track. Null when the finding is not grouped.

status.description: utkast, bekreftet or trukket. Not the assessment.

tittel.description: Title. The long description is omitted.

funn_antall.description: Matching findings. Zero is an empty register, not an unavailable one.

inneholder_fortrolig.description: True when any matching finding is marked confidential, including rows past the cap.

missing_sources.description: Sources with no record. Missing data stays visible and is never treated as a positive result.

operation_id.description: Revly operation ID for this read, recorded in the access log.

source.description: Source that contributed to the result.

version.description: Latest version marker as text. Null when Revly has no version.

sources.description: Sources that contributed to the result.

status.description: Result status. not_found_or_unavailable means the engagement is not visible to this connection and the call is an error.

truncated.description: True when findings or their sources were cut.

title: Hent granskningsfunn fra Revly
